reason: For an attention-precision role, prioritize vdown4-rest3-g128: it protects every value projection, the attention output path (down projections), embedding, and head at 4 bits while keeping other weights at 3 bits, making it a targeted memory-saving hypothesis. Next, mixed3-4-g64 tests finer quantization groups with the measured mixed 3/4 pattern; int3-g64 tests whether finer groups rescue quality at lower memory. These are unmeasured hypotheses, not established gate passes. Existing evidence shows int4-g128 at quality 1.0 but higher memory, while int3-g128 and mixed3-4-g128 miss the 0.95 quality gate. BF16 throughput and heldout quality are absent. All recipes are ranked once; the top two are the attention-precision recommendations within the two-trial budget.
